pick.title: Ensemble data assimilation of fault stress

option.title: Ensemble data assimilation of fault stress
option.summary: Assimilate surface deformation into an ensemble of fault simulations to estimate stress and forecast ruptures.
option.root_link: Tests whether forecast skill is limited by compute or by observing stress at depth.
option.compute_open: Ensemble members: published skill curves stop at 150 members https://academic.oup.com/gji/article/217/3/1453/5307884; skill above that, under model error, is unknown.
option.distance_reason: Forecasting earthquakes is the root question's object of study.

scores.reason: Refines whether to buy ensemble members or sensors, but only in a synthetic world.
Skill beyond 150 members is unmeasured and reachable on one machine.

root_question: Why can't we predict earthquakes days or hours ahead? Is the cause physics that is chaotic at root, or mostly a data problem? Would huge foundation models trained with heavy GPU parallelism on waveforms, GPS strain and fault simulations get anywhere? Or is compute not the blocker?

plan.option_title: Ensemble data assimilation of fault stress
plan.question: On a simulated fault with known physics, does earthquake-forecast skill keep rising as the ensemble grows, or level off early?
plan.hypothesis: Skill levels off at tens to hundreds of members, because model error and unobserved stress at depth limit it first.

predictions.if_lever: With model error or particle filters, skill keeps rising past 1,024 members by more than a deep stress sensor adds.
predictions.if_not: Skill plateaus by 256 members in every Kalman-filter arm. Model error or a deep sensor moves skill more than ensemble size does.
predictions.decision_rule: Plateau size is the smallest ensemble whose area skill score is within one standard error of the largest; not the lever if it is at most 256 in every Kalman arm.
predictions.noise_rule: Standard error of the area skill score across 5 independent truths.
predictions.expected_why: Both prior studies found 20 to 30 members resolve the significant spread.

plan.compute_tested_why: Only ensemble size varies within each arm.
plan.scored_against: earthquakes in the hidden true run
